location_address: 7001 Shrimp Rd Dock A Slip #32 Stock Island, FL US 33040
description:
A four-hour private sandbar charter to whichever of the Lower Keys’ hidden shallows is firing that day — Snipes Keys, Jewfish Basin, Mud Keys, Sand Key, or one of the unnamed flats only seasoned local captains know. We anchor in waist-deep crystal water, deploy floats and a Lily Pad, and you get a Key West sandbar afternoon without the crowd. Your USCG-licensed captain picks the spot based on wind, tide, and what your group wants.

Quick facts: 

• 4 hrs $1,195 
• Private 
• USCG-licensed captain 
• Perry Hotel & Marina 
• Fuel + safety gear included

what_is_included_items.value: Large lily pad (upon request at the dock)
Stand-up paddleboard  (upon request at the dock)

what_is_not_included_items.value: Tipping the Captain and Crew: If you are satisfied, the minimum tip is typically not less than 20%.

itinerary:
Departure – Perry Hotel & Marina
Meet your local Six Fins captain at Dock A, Slip #32. After a brief safety overview, we cruise out through calm backcountry waters toward remote sandbars known primarily to locals.

Scenic Backcountry Cruise
Enjoy a relaxing ride through turquoise shallows, mangrove islands, and open Gulf waters. Keep an eye out for dolphins, rays, and seabirds along the way.

Secret Sandbar Experience
Arrive at a secluded sandbar or uninhabited island selected based on tides and conditions. Step into warm, crystal-clear water, float, swim, explore tide pools, or simply relax in peaceful seclusion.

Use the lily pad, paddleboard, noodles, or enjoy music and refreshments while anchored in your private paradise.

Optional Exploration
Time permitting, your captain may reposition to a second sandbar or scenic location to give you multiple perspectives of the backcountry.

Return Cruise
Relax and soak in the views as we cruise back toward the marina — refreshed, sun-kissed, and crowd-free.

check_in_details:
Parking and Location:

Arrive 15 minutes before departure.

what_to_bring_items.value: Sea sickness medicine (wristband type is best)

special_requirements:
• Children under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.
• Infants and toddlers must have a properly fitting U.S. Coast Guard–approved life jacket (guests must provide infant/toddler sizes).
• All guests must be comfortable around water.
• Guests who plan to swim or use water equipment should have basic swimming ability.
• The primary booking party must be at least 21 years old.
• Bareboat charters (7–8 passengers) require a designated renter 21+ to complete the Bareboat Agreement prior to arrival.
• Guests must follow all captain instructions for safety at all times.
restrictions:
This experience may not be suitable for everyone.

• Not recommended for guests with serious back, neck, heart, or mobility conditions.
• Guests must be able to board and disembark the vessel with limited assistance.
• Guests should be comfortable walking on uneven sand and entering shallow water.
• Basic swimming ability is strongly recommended for those participating in water activities.
• Excessive intoxication is not permitted and may result in denial of boarding or early termination without refund.
• Smoking or vaping is not permitted inside the cabin.

If you have medical concerns or physical limitations, please consult your physician prior to booking and notify us in advance so we can determine if this trip is appropriate.
extras: - Fuel is extra for trips with over six passengers at $35/hour
disclaimers:
All itineraries are subject to weather, sea conditions, tides, U.S. Coast Guard advisories, and captain discretion. Your safety and comfort are our highest priority, and locations may be adjusted as needed to ensure the best possible experience.

Sandbar access is tide-dependent. Water depth, visibility, and positioning of sandbars may vary daily.

Wildlife sightings, including dolphins, rays, and marine life, are common but cannot be guaranteed.

Guests are responsible for arriving on time. Late arrivals may reduce charter time without refund.

Six Fins is not responsible for personal items lost, stolen, or damaged during the charter.

Failure to follow captain instructions or engaging in unsafe behavior may result in early termination of the charter without refund.
